Aileen.japanese_name: アイリーン＝オラサバル
Aileen.register: Proud, sharp, self-reliant, aristocratic yet hardened by criminal upbringing
Aileen.voice_notes: Speaks with dignity and bite. Never meek or helpless. Inner monologues are analytical, pragmatic, and wryly humorous. Uses formal address with parents and superiors, but blunt with suitors and peers.

Curtis.register: Gentle, polite, deceptively soft-spoken, chillingly sociopathic
Curtis.voice_notes: Always smiles and speaks pleasantly even when discussing torture or murder. Uses polite forms of address ('Milady', 'Princess') with a musical, relaxed cadence. Beneath the placid exterior lies zero hesitation to kill.

Roberto.japanese_name: ロベルト＝クロムウェル
Roberto.voice_notes: Energetic and theatrical. Speaks with the flair of an ambitious gambler who lives for thrills. Flirtatious and irreverent toward royal authority, treating negotiations as a game.

Shark.role: President of the Merchants' Guild, Smuggler
Shark.voice_notes: Values time and profit above all. Speaks concisely and analytically, rarely displaying overt emotion. Beneath his cold business demeanor is a man burdened by past betrayals.

Stuart.voice_notes: Obsessed with cleanliness and order; despises dirt and physical contact. Highly educated, speaks with cutting precision and haughty elegance. Constantly bickers with his cousin Tyrone.

Tyrone.voice_notes: Speaks directly and loudly with visceral honesty. Hates scheming and deception. Strong protective instincts toward Aileen, quick to anger, deeply loyal.

Lyle.register: Exasperated, strict, dryly sarcastic, paternal mentor
Lyle.voice_notes: Calls Aileen 'Milady' (姫様) with weary exasperation. High standards, sharp reprimands, zero tolerance for slackers, but deeply dedicated to her survival.

Meisen.japanese_name: マイセン＝ヒルデガルド
Meisen.voice_notes: Playful and buoyant. Talks like an eccentric traveler who finds the criminal empire delightfully quaint.

Michael.voice_notes: Speaks with monotone depression. Frequently asks if he can die now. Unflinching dark comedic presence.
